kinds.d: A hard-wearing mat laid at a door to wipe shoes and catch dirt.
An absorbent mat laid beside a bath or shower to stand on with wet feet.
A mat or runner laid in front of a kitchen counter or sink to stand on while working.
A mat laid under a desk chair to protect the floor and let castors roll.

notes: All four old kinds kept with their old sources; materials and anti-fatigue mat recorded as types. Kept the single old Wellness Mats model. Meditation mat moved to Cushions per plan (not on this shelf). No web research.
